stage_b_execution_freeze_commit: resolved at runtime from git log for execution.json

stage_b_state_machine.complete_unsealed: Validate all 192 records and provenance, make zero provider calls, then seal.
stage_b_state_machine.fresh: Atomically create the execution manifest before provider construction or invocation.
stage_b_state_machine.invalid: Reject invalid JSON, invalid terminal records, duplicates, foreign IDs, non-prefix order, more than 192 rows, or a non-exact 192-ID set.
stage_b_state_machine.manifest_only: Validate the existing execution manifest and resume at cell 1 without overwriting it.
stage_b_state_machine.partial: Validate the execution manifest and every existing record, then resume only the remaining frozen-order suffix.
